semantic_review_notes: Demo renderer coverage proves every registered preview screen renders, restored payment previews use explicit illustrative content, Report Issue exposes guest-safe vehicle data without custody/staff/internal identifiers, report references and monetary values are bidi-isolated in RTL, shared request-error UI is reused, and DemoNavigator renders nothing in production.
invariants_error_checks: no slot/spot/staff/audit internals in Report Issue
limits: Preview-only surface; static rendering does not exercise live guest mutation authority.

semantic_review_notes: Presentation matrix renders the complete demo screen registry and all three overlays across English/Arabic and light/dark combinations, exercising direction/theme composition without invoking production mutations.
invariants_error_checks: all screen states render in 2 locales x 2 themes
Arabic and dark composition do not crash
limits: Render-to-static-markup matrix checks survivability/content, not pixel geometry or live browser interaction.

semantic_review_notes: QR matrix contract verifies the standards-required four-module quiet zone around the encoded core and a safe null result for payloads too large to encode.
limits: Matrix structure is asserted; physical camera/scanner interoperability is outside this unit test.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted handoff trust-fence tests prove plaintext pickup/QR proof disappears immediately on freshness/offline loss and is not silently reissued on reconnect, accepts a proof only through the expected mutation reconciliation gap, drops late ISSUE results after trust loss, rejects old-client/old-visit results after replacement, and clears expired proof without automatic issue/rotation.
invariants_error_checks: proof visible only while current visit is HANDOFF_PENDING and fresh
late old generation cannot overwrite new proof
limits: Mounted fake DOM; server-side proof issuance uniqueness/expiry remains API responsibility.

semantic_review_notes: Integration-style mounted test covers successful handoff POST followed by failed canonical GET reconciliation. The coordinator becomes untrusted, the returned plaintext proof is never displayed, and a later successful GET restores session trust without resurrecting or reissuing that proof.
invariants_error_checks: POST result alone cannot become trusted after reconciliation failure
proof remains null through later GET recovery
limits: Uses mocked API responses around the real coordinator/hook composition.

semantic_review_notes: Handoff recovery tests verify PIN-to-QR rotations are single-flight, completed lifecycle discards cached secrets, ALREADY_ISSUED requires explicit rotation while ALREADY_VERIFIED blocks it, and network/503/429 issue failures are surfaced without automatic replay on rerender.
invariants_error_checks: duplicate rotate produces one API call
completed visit has no retained proof
limits: Mock transport; recovery codes are assumed to be server-authoritative.

semantic_review_notes: Unit tests for handoff mutation fencing prove synchronous single-flight admission, stale-result classification after visit generation replacement, distinct already-issued/already-verified recovery states, and wall-clock expiry that never yields negative countdown.
limits: Coordinator fixture models generation semantics without live browser/session transport.

semantic_review_notes: Mounted post-visit policy tests prove automatic rating entry requires independent latest COMPLETED authorization, never submits a rating, respects exact-context dismissal across rerenders/remount, does not override explicit payment selection, fails closed for invalid/ambiguous/network/non-completed authority, fences late authorization after dismissal or visit/client replacement, and does not carry Visit A dismissal into Visit B.
limits: SessionStorage is represented by a test Map; production key also incorporates browser presentation context marker/nonce.

semantic_review_notes: Production post-visit surfaces are mounted across EN/AR light/dark. Payment view uses canonical projection without overstating a receipt, post-visit authority is revalidated before loading payment data and fails closed when unavailable, and rating starts with zero preselection plus disabled submit.
invariants_error_checks: authority failure exposes only Back and performs no payment read
limits: API methods are mocked; 24-hour post-visit eligibility enforcement remains server-side.

semantic_review_notes: Rating mutation coordinator tests prove duplicate presses serialize to one POST, visit/client replacement or explicit invalidation suppresses stale success, a response for another visit is never accepted as saved, and ambiguous/conflict/unavailable/rate-limit outcomes are classified without automatic retry.
invariants_error_checks: one in-flight POST per exact client+visit
stale response produces no success callback
limits: Server idempotency/immutability is not exercised by this unit test.

semantic_review_notes: Presentation-outcome binding records saved/conflict/unknown only after an explicit submit, treats unknown as dismissed rather than submitted, and refuses to update another visit or a disposed/invalidated presentation policy.
invariants_error_checks: only explicit submit outcome changes presentation memory
limits: Presentation memory is explicitly non-authoritative and is tested separately from server rating state.

semantic_review_notes: Rating presentation policy is exact-context UI memory only: duplicate effects get one pending attempt, intentional dismissal/submitted state persists only for the exact key, unknown suppresses repeat prompts without claiming success, transient failed outcome stays pending, invalidation blocks late callbacks, unavailable storage falls back to in-memory suppression, and invalid persisted values are ignored.
invariants_error_checks: failed is not treated as submitted
unknown does not claim server success
limits: Storage controls prompt presentation only; it is not evidence of server rating or authorization.

semantic_review_notes: Foreground audio helper attempts the Customer-owned vehicle-ready sound once only while visible and contains both synchronous and rejected playback failures without retry or impact on canonical session state.
limits: Browser autoplay/device behavior is intentionally best-effort.

semantic_review_notes: Ready-alert tracker baselines the first authorized snapshot without presentation, presents one later ready identity composed from valetSessionId plus readyAt exactly once including skipped READY-to-HANDOFF_PENDING observation, records/suppresses COMPLETED and policy-disabled identities, never replays the same identity, and resets/baselines on a different valet session.
invariants_error_checks: policy-disabled identity consumed without later replay
session replacement clears tracker and baselines new session
limits: Tracker lifetime is in-memory; provider recreation on client replacement supplies authority separation.

semantic_review_notes: Vehicle-ready alert presentation renders localized LTR/RTL accessible status copy with polite live-region semantics, contains no session identifiers/timestamps, and dismisses only through a local callback. Provider composition additionally scopes visibility to the current client, fresh/non-expired authority.
invariants_error_checks: dismiss has no API side effect
provider renders only for current client and fresh authority
limits: Static rendering test; provider authority composition was inspected separately.

semantic_review_notes: Shared API error envelope is strict and requires non-empty code/message plus a bounded 1-128 character requestId limited to safe token characters, preventing arbitrary response metadata from crossing the common error boundary.
limits: This schema defines transport shape only; individual endpoint error-code allowlists are separate contracts.

semantic_review_notes: Common investigation tests reject invalid/offset/local timestamps, contradictory current labels, person email leakage, source-coverage metadata widening, client-injected role authority, raw plate in cursor payload, wrong cursor purpose/precision, and cursor lifetime beyond 15 minutes.
invariants_error_checks: UTC time is real and bounded precision
limits: Cryptographic HMAC verification itself lives in API cursor implementation, not this contract test.

semantic_review_notes: Issue #300 common contracts separate public safe labels/persons/references/coverage from server-only read scope and signed cursor payload. Cursors are purpose-discriminated, session/scope/filter/snapshot bound, microsecond-keyset precise, strict, and limited to 15 minutes while comments explicitly forbid PII/filter text/credentials/raw metadata.
invariants_error_checks: safe current labels cannot contradict unavailable flag
snapshotAt clock equals snapshotCutoff millisecond prefix
HMAC payload fields digest-only for viewer/filter
limits: Schema cannot prove the caller actually derives read scope from the active session; API consumers were inspected and perform server-side authorization.

semantic_review_notes: Detail tests constrain path source to the known catalog, reject free-form routing/raw incident description/private dispatch reason, require source/key agreement, and permit null key slot only for the authentic RELEASED custody event rather than slot-required custody kinds.
limits: Tests contract projection, not underlying database evidence provenance.

semantic_review_notes: Strict source-discriminated detail projection exposes only bounded common evidence plus approved source-specific facts. Audit unknown kinds remain metadata-free, incidents expose current status/type/severity only, and super-refinement prevents source/key mismatch and invalid slot-less custody facts.
limits: Kind string for AUDIT is intentionally extensible but still metadata-free.

semantic_review_notes: Selector-directory tests enforce purpose-limited MEMBER/KEY_SLOT searches, text <=80, page <=20, no email-query flag, and response items containing only exact ID plus current safe label with no contact fields.
limits: Authorization of inactive historical resources is server-side; contract only limits the selector wire shape.

semantic_review_notes: Filter contract allows only MEMBER/KEY_SLOT kind, bounded optional text, opaque cursor and max-20 page. Exact Location is deliberately absent from client overrides; responses expose only ID/current label and enforce continuation consistency.
limits: Opaque cursor authenticity is enforced by API cursor layer rather than this public string schema.

semantic_review_notes: Search tests reject organization/client-authority and metadata query fields, cap limit at 100 and window at positive <=31 elapsed days, reject fabricated total counts, and preserve the semantic distinction between current vehicle/state labels and typed historical match witnesses.
invariants_error_checks: employee participation role only on employee match
current state must use staff session catalog
limits: The contract accepts plate/make/model search text within bounds; search normalization and tenant scoping are performed server-side.

semantic_review_notes: Search contract supports bounded AND-style discovery filters over a 31-day UTC window while excluding scope/authority fields. Results separate current vehicle/key-slot/session facts from historical match reasons, bound counts/reasons/pages, and expose explicit per-source coverage instead of implying completeness.
limits: matchingRecordCount and incident counts are bounded to 100000 but not cross-reconciled with matchReasons because reasons are a capped evidence projection.

semantic_review_notes: Timeline tests keep the canonical full timeline distinct from discovery-window filters, cap pages at 100, require canonical source/event IDs, reject raw evidence metadata and unsafe references, force ASC ordering, and expose current actor/vehicle labels only through approved safe projections.
limits: Chronological ordering is explicitly not a causal/completeness assertion.

semantic_review_notes: Timeline contract deliberately has no discovery from/to filters: it reads one canonical session timeline with opaque cursor and max-100 page. Events are source-discriminated, expose only approved actor/current vehicle/reference/coverage facts, and the response is strict with ASC order plus continuation consistency.
callers_consumers: API audit investigation timeline controller/read service
limits: Timeline sequence is observational evidence; contract does not claim causality or completeness beyond explicit coverage.

semantic_review_notes: Pre-custody cancellation tests require exact task/shift IDs and positive session/task versions, reject client-supplied organization/state/actor authority, and require canonical status evidence rather than treating a missing task as successful cancellation. Response widening with PII is rejected.
invariants_error_checks: CANCELLED outcome requires full terminal evidence
limits: Server command/history logic determines whether custody has advanced and whether the exact shift/task remains authorized.

semantic_review_notes: Cancellation wire contract carries only task identity, expected session/task versions and expected shift. Status projection distinguishes CANCELLED from NOT_CANCELLED with PRE_CUSTODY/ADVANCED classification and minimal versioned session/task evidence, with strict objects throughout.
invariants_error_checks: NOT_CANCELLED cannot masquerade as terminal success
limits: Exact authorization and custody classification are enforced in the server controller/command history, not encoded in the public request.

semantic_review_notes: Incomplete Check-In cancellation tests enforce exact expected lifecycle version/shift and reject actor/state/reason/org/timestamp authority fields. Terminal response is minimal, and the tests explicitly prove CANCELLED is not widened into guest-safe or active staff-directory contracts.
invariants_error_checks: guest-safe and active directory remain closed to CANCELLED
limits: The server determines whether the current lifecycle is still incomplete and whether the shift has authority.

semantic_review_notes: Strict Check-In cancellation request carries only expected version and expected shift; terminal response returns session/location/version with literal CANCELLED, while the reconciliation status response uses the canonical staff valet-session state catalog without extra evidence or secrets.
invariants_error_checks: terminal mutation cannot claim another state
limits: Status response can represent nonterminal canonical states for reconciliation; authorization and transition validity remain server responsibilities.

semantic_review_notes: Shared Check-In identity contracts distinguish human-confirmed plate from temporary descriptor and make vehicle details strict. Detail strings are trimmed/NFKC-normalized and bounded to 80 Unicode code points; deeper identity normalization/bounds are also revalidated by server vehicle-identity logic before persistence.
invariants_error_checks: confirmed plate carries explicit confirmedByHuman field
vehicle details strict and <=80 code points
limits: Raw plate/temporary-descriptor fields are intentionally normalized and bounded at the server domain layer in addition to the public contract.

semantic_review_notes: Guest-access tests pin raw guest credentials to exactly 32 CSPRNG bytes encoded as 43 unpadded base64url characters and reject padding/non-base64url/non-string material. Guest-safe session readiness accepts canonical UTC timestamps and strict projection rejects organization scope leakage.
callers_consumers: guest issuance and customer session clients
limits: Token entropy/generation and one-time issuance semantics are implemented server-side; this test verifies the public wire boundary.

semantic_review_notes: Phone tests accept employee presentation variants for Jordan mobiles and normalize them to one canonical +9627xxxxxxxx wire value, while malformed lengths/prefixes/text are rejected. DIFFERENT_CUSTOMER accepts only the canonical wire form.
limits: This is intentionally Jordan-specific validation and does not claim international phone support.

semantic_review_notes: Check-In transport contracts are strict across intake/customer intent, vehicle identity/details, condition evidence, guest-access issue/revoke, completion and guest-safe session/branding projections. Although several raw wire strings are intentionally broad, caller inspection confirms the server re-normalizes before persistence: intake operation IDs are constrained to 8-128 safe characters, display name to 120 code points, vehicle identity/details to domain limits, and condition notes to bounded non-control text.
invariants_error_checks: guest branding displayName bounded/no control chars and uppercase hex color
server domain layer revalidates broad raw fields before DB
limits: Contract alone is not the complete validation boundary for raw intake/condition strings; no issue is claimed because authoritative server consumers apply stricter normalization before persistence.

semantic_review_notes: Company analytics tests require truthful null metrics for empty samples, explicit coverage, weighted aggregate counts without per-employee disclosure, deterministic timezone ordering, bounded grouping arrays, and reject guest-rating/returning-contact/byEmployee or malformed numeric widening.
limits: Contract validates aggregate shape/coherence; SQL aggregation correctness and entitlement are server-service concerns.

semantic_review_notes: Company analytics response is an aggregate-only strict projection with explicit location/timezone coverage, bounded operational/financial/incident groups, fixed-precision ratios, and KPI evidence counts. It deliberately omits staff-level breakdown and contact/guest identity data while reusing controlled location analytics schemas.
invariants_error_checks: timezone boundary array max500 and strictly ordered
limits: Cross-field arithmetic beyond explicitly modeled ratios/count semantics is computed and validated by the server query layer.

semantic_review_notes: Company report tests require DAILY reports to include only controlled dispatch/key-custody aggregate activity, keep WEEKLY/MONTHLY free of daily activity, bound event groups to their catalogs, reuse the company analytics summary, and allow only existing CSV/PDF export requests while rejecting XLSX or contact inclusion.
limits: Report file generation/content is server-side; contract constrains request and structured report projection.

semantic_review_notes: Company report contracts reuse existing bounded period/export schemas and company aggregate summary. DAILY adds only aggregate retrieval, dispatch and key-custody counts; WEEKLY/MONTHLY carry no raw daily activity, with strict envelopes and organization/date fields.
limits: Authorization for the organization and exact period derivation are server-side management concerns.

semantic_review_notes: Complete-handoff tests limit the mutation request to expected session version only and require a minimal terminal projection where retrieval request, task and session all agree on COMPLETED. Extra verification/internal identifiers are rejected.
limits: Proof verification, custody release and authority checks occur in the server command before this terminal response.

semantic_review_notes: Strict handoff completion contract uses only optimistic session version input and returns the exact terminal session/task projection without custody secret, proof, actor or scope material.
invariants_error_checks: session state/task status/retrieval status literals COMPLETED
limits: The request intentionally does not carry task/actor authority; server derives and locks authoritative state.

semantic_review_notes: Condition-photo tests validate the complete PENDING/VERIFIED/EXPIRED/REJECTED state machine, byte/retry/timestamp bounds, exact-session state discovery, multipart metadata restricted to operationId, empty reconciliation/query contracts, and explicit rejection of storage URLs/keys/hashes/lease/auth/scope/user metadata from public responses.
invariants_error_checks: pending/latest operation must match requested session
limits: Actual JPEG decoding and multipart single-file/stream byte enforcement are implemented in API condition-photo parsing/backend layers.

semantic_review_notes: Verified-photo wire v1 is intentionally provider-neutral and strict: 8MiB JPEG cap, bounded retry advice, safe public error catalog, state-discriminated operation results, operationId-only multipart metadata, empty reconcile/query bodies, policy source limited to organization default/location override, and state discovery binds operation evidence to the exact valet session.
invariants_error_checks: no storage/hash/credential fields in public schemas
limits: The multipart parser enforces image count/bytes and backend qualification; this contract constrains metadata/result transport.

semantic_review_notes: Confirm Parked tests require session/task CAS versions, trimmed nonempty key-slot code and exactly one parking resource code, with optional spot ID only alongside spot code. Success projection is terminal/minimal and deliberately excludes key-slot detail.
invariants_error_checks: exactly one spot or zone code
test_refs: server confirm-parked resource lock files inspected
limits: Resource codes have no public max length, but server uses trimmed values only in parameterized, tenant/location-scoped exact resource queries and compatibility/occupancy locks; no injection/authority defect was found.

semantic_review_notes: Confirm Parked contract carries only optimistic versions plus key-slot and one parking resource identity, with refinements preventing contradictory resource shapes. Server consumer inspection confirms codes are resolved under authoritative organization/location, active/compatibility/occupancy locks and parameterized SQL before parking state commits.
invariants_error_checks: optional spot ID coupled to spot code
limits: Contract itself does not carry organization/location/actor authority by design; those are derived server-side.

semantic_review_notes: Feedback analytics tests enforce truthful completed/rated cohort arithmetic, null semantics, 1-5 rating bounds, participation/average consistency, at most four recent rows, and a pseudonymous VISIT reference while rejecting guest phone/name/internal session identity and unsupported scope.
invariants_error_checks: participation null iff eligible=0 and matches ratio otherwise
limits: Pseudonymous visit-reference generation and cohort SQL are server-side; the contract prevents raw identity fields in the response.

semantic_review_notes: Customer feedback analytics is a strict COMPANY/LOCATION aggregate projection with nonnegative safe counts, fixed-precision average/participation, bounded 1-5 distribution, and four recent pseudonymous rows carrying only visit reference, rating, timestamps, authorized location label and timezone. Super-refinement enforces cohort arithmetic.
invariants_error_checks: visit reference pattern VISIT- plus 12 uppercase hex
limits: Authorized location label is current display data; contract does not expose immutable location IDs in recent rows.

semantic_review_notes: Feature-authority tests keep Visit Contacts organization-scoped, allow Management Audit organization or exact-location queries, and validate only truthful role/scope projections: org admin organization, location manager grant-set for Visit Contacts, and exact-location authority for Management Audit including permitted supervisor scope.
invariants_error_checks: Visit Contacts rejects location query override
Audit query may include exact location
Location Manager cannot receive organization-wide Audit authority
limits: Query organization/location IDs still require server-side session/grant authorization; the API controller/service supplies the authoritative projection.

semantic_review_notes: Dashboard feature-authority contract strictly models only VISIT_CONTACTS and MANAGEMENT_AUDIT, validates feature-specific query scope, and constrains server responses to ORG_ADMIN/LOCATION_MANAGER/VALET_SUPERVISOR with ORGANIZATION, ORGANIZATION_GRANT_SET or exact LOCATION combinations that are valid for that feature.
invariants_error_checks: Audit organization scope only org admin
limits: Schema validates projection consistency; server still verifies membership, tenant, grants and entitlement before constructing it.

semantic_review_notes: Dispatch tests cover self/explicit/automatic assignment shapes, reject client organization/membership query authority and conflicting automatic target, normalize/bound reasons, keep task projections minimal, strictly constrain queue vehicle fields, and require tracking to be explicit opt-in with a privacy-minimal movement projection.
invariants_error_checks: no key-slot/SLA or extra vehicle metadata in base task
tracking false rejected and tracking details absent from base response
limits: Assignment eligibility, exact location authority and task ownership transitions are enforced by dispatch server commands.

semantic_review_notes: Dispatch contracts use strict versioned task projections, a safe staff queue vehicle descriptor, location-scoped queue query with explicit tracking opt-in, privacy-minimal tracking projection, and strict assign/accept/decline/reassign requests. CANCELLED valet sessions are excluded from active task-queue items.
invariants_error_checks: task status limited to active queue states
queue query only locationId plus optional true tracking
limits: Queue arrays are not contract-capped here; server query bounds/pagination/load characteristics determine operational response size.
